title: DuckDB Pipeline Plan
description: A structured description of a DuckDB analytics pipeline, so this skill's Quality Gates (OLAP-only, single writer, explicit types, projection/filter pushdown, ZSTD, credential hygiene) can be checked deterministically by scripts/duckdb_pipeline_audit.mjs.

workloadType.description: The workload class. DuckDB is only the right tool for olap.

environment.description: Exploratory notebook work, or a scheduled/production pipeline (stricter gates).

concurrentWriters.description: How many processes hold write transactions on the same database file. DuckDB is single-writer.

readsCsv.description: True if the pipeline reads CSV inputs.

csvTypeStrategy.description: Whether CSV column types are locked with read_csv(columns={...}) or auto-detected with read_csv_auto.

columnProjection.description: Whether queries project only needed columns or SELECT *.

filterPushdown.description: Where row filtering happens: inside DuckDB SQL (pushdown) or after materializing everything into pandas.

writesParquet.description: True if the pipeline exports Parquet via COPY TO.

parquetCompression.description: Compression codec for Parquet output; ZSTD is the production default.

partitionColumnCardinality.description: Cardinality of the PARTITION_BY column(s), if partitioned output is written.

usesHttpfs.description: True if the pipeline reads s3:// / https:// data via the httpfs extension.

extensionLoadPaired.description: True if every INSTALL is paired with a LOAD in the session (or a persistent DB carries the extension).

s3CredentialsInVersionControl.description: True if S3 access keys appear in committed SQL/notebooks/config.

duckdbVersionPinned.description: True if the DuckDB version is pinned for the pipeline.
